summary: Message Fact + Runtime Ingestion Foundation：0008_message_facts.sql（v7->v8，fact contract 先于存储形状 DP-83）；MessageRecord/SqliteMessageRepository 扩展 typed 事实列（actor/content/time/provenance）；thin Main message-ingestion boundary（observed_at 由 boundary 产生 DP-87，typed text-first DP-88，actor customer|agent DP-86/I-15）；SqliteMessageRepository 接入 production Main 共享 m10Sqlite.conn（DP-90）；v7->v8 传播全部更新；8 个 foundation guard 测试（fresh 1->8 / v7->v8 upgrade / I-16 unknown preservation / production shared-connection / round-trip / equal-time ordering / conversation isolation / fail-closed）

owner_tightening.dp83_contract_precedes_storage: 遵守：先定义 identity/actor/content/time/ordering/source-provenance 语义再落存储；0008 不是机械四列
owner_tightening.dp86_actor_distinct_from_llm_roles: 遵守：actor = customer|agent（最小集合，无 AI actor）；I-15 generation provenance 与 actor 正交（未建模，真实 producer 出现后再定义）
owner_tightening.i15_actor_generation_orthogonal: 遵守：AI-assisted generation provenance 不等于 message actor；actor taxonomy 不含 AI/system
owner_tightening.dp87_time_semantics_explicit: 遵守：occurred_at（source/platform，可 unknown）与 observed_at（Fast Sheep，ingestion boundary 产生）显式区分；不使用含糊 created_at；observed_at 不冒充 occurred_at（测试断言）
owner_tightening.dp88_content_typed_extensible_text_first: 遵守：content_kind='text'（CHECK）+ content_text；ingestion 强制 typed text；attachments/rich payload 留 SHEEP-065
owner_tightening.source_provenance_minimal_typed: 遵守：external_ref + occurred_at + observed_at 最小 typed facts；无 metadata JSON bag
owner_tightening.external_ref_uniqueness: 遵守：Read First 确认 uniqueness scope 未契约化；未加猜测性 UNIQUE；internal MessageId authoritative（I-13）
owner_tightening.ingestion_thin_append: 遵守：saveNormalizedMessage = plain INSERT；无 dedupe/edit/recall/reconciliation/idempotency policy（DEFER 真实 producer）
owner_tightening.dp90_shared_db_lifecycle: 遵守：SqliteMessageRepository(m10Sqlite.conn) 共享既有生产 DB connection/lifecycle；未二次 openDatabase；production failure 不 silent fallback memory
owner_tightening.migration_fresh_and_upgrade: 遵守：fresh 0001->0008 与 v7->v8 upgrade 均验证；0001~0007 checksum 不变
owner_tightening.i16_no_fabricated_history: 遵守：legacy fact-less 行 5 个事实列全部 NULL；无 system/空文本/migration-time backfill
owner_tightening.observed_at_produced_at_boundary: 遵守：observed_at 由 Main ingestion boundary 产生；repository 只保存事实不制造 provenance
owner_tightening.i12_ordering_policy: 遵守：排序策略与持久化事实分离；occurred_at 已知升序 + equal-time id tie-breaker；unknown 置后；local ingestion order 不冒充 source absolute order；测试覆盖 equal-time tie
owner_tightening.required_tests: 遵守：fresh/v7->v8 upgrade/legacy unknown preservation/production shared-connection/close-reopen round-trip/deterministic+equal-time ordering/conversation isolation 全覆盖
owner_tightening.forbidden_kept: 遵守：未实现 Timeline IPC/UI、Composer、Attachments、Unread、真实平台 producer、sync/Outbox
owner_tightening.unread_readiness: 遵守：PR1 PASS 后 UNREAD_FACT_READINESS 不自动变 READY；输出 PARTIALLY_READY / STILL_BLOCKED_BY_READER_PROGRESS

fact_readiness.MESSAGE_FACT_PATH: READY for Timeline foundation (identity/actor/content/time/ordering/source-provenance persisted; production ingestion boundary + shared DB lifecycle; Timeline UI remains SHEEP-063 after Owner PASS)
fact_readiness.UNREAD_FACT_READINESS: PARTIALLY_READY / STILL_BLOCKED_BY_READER_PROGRESS (message identity/order/time facts now exist; reader identity + read-progress watermark still required; never auto-READY)
